pattern: SELECT .+ FROM teacher JOIN \(\s*(SELECT Teacher\_ID, MIN\(Age\) AS MinAge FROM teacher GROUP BY Teacher\_ID )\s*\) AS YoungestTeacher ON teacher\.Teacher\_ID = YoungestTeacher\.Teacher\_ID AND teacher\.Age = YoungestTeacher\.MinAge
correction: Use ORDER BY and LIMIT to find the youngest teacher instead of joining with a subquery.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that use a subquery in an incorrect manner, such as trying to find the youngest teacher. Instead, it suggests using ORDER BY and LIMIT to correctly retrieve the desired information.
